cohort: 764 Chinese women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who had a singleton delivery.
finding: Maternal overweight/obesity and gestational weight gain were significantly associated with various adverse pregnancy outcomes in women with GDM, with obese mothers having excessive GWG conferring the greatest risk.
mod_finding: Maternal overweight/obesity was associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery, while inadequate GWG was associated with a lower likelihood of cesarean delivery.
